description: South Korea early loan repayment fee (jungdo sanghwan susuryo): repaid amount x fee rate x remaining days / fee period (usually 3 years, after which the fee is waived).

elapsedDays.description: Days since the loan was taken out

feePeriodDays.description: Period during which the fee applies, in days; default 1095 (3 years)

feeRatePct.description: Fee rate in percent from the loan contract, e.g. 1.2

name: early_repayment_fee
